description: This Java class 'NettyResponseWriter' handles sending HTTP responses over Netty channels, managing socket connection closure, delays, and logging connection events.

classes.name: NettyResponseWriter
classes.description: Handles writing HTTP responses to Netty channels, managing connection options, delays, and logging.

methods.name: NettyResponseWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the response writer with configuration, logger, channel context, and scheduler.

methods.name: sendResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response and manages socket closure based on connection options.

methods.name: writeAndCloseSocket
methods.description: Writes the response to the channel and closes the socket if required, considering delays.

methods.name: disconnectAndCloseChannel
methods.description: Disconnects and closes the channel, with logging of connection events and errors.
